column1: # Signed energy components of the recorded H2-A-01 single point, drawn by tools/render_h2_energy_components.py.
# Values are strings in hartree (Eh) and are printed as given. The sign convention is the one the independent review established
# for this engine build: the reported total includes the nuclear repulsion (the printed nuclear repulsion, one-electron and
# two-electron energies sum to the printed total, redacted/psi4-output.dat lines 181-184), so electronic energy = reported total
# minus reported nuclear repulsion. The electronic value is that independent review's derivation, attributed to it; the engine did not
# print it. The script checks the identity in exact decimal arithmetic and draws the three table values.

column4: independent review: reported total minus reported nuclear repulsion, for this build (redacted/psi4-output.dat:181-184)
